S: A man followed me into the empty stairwell of the parking garage and blocked the exit door.
N: A man walked into the stairwell of the parking garage and held the exit door for me.

S: The police called to say my car had been found burned out and asked when I had last seen my brother, who borrowed it.
N: The garage called to say my car had been washed and asked when I would pick it up, since my brother had dropped it off.

S: Through the wall at night, I heard the man next door shouting and then a loud crash, and then silence.
N: Through the wall at night, I heard the man next door talking on the phone and then a television show.

S: The insurance company said my policy had lapsed last month, the week before my house flooded.
N: The insurance company said my policy would renew next month, the week after my house inspection.

S: When I stood up, the room spun, my speech came out slurred, and my coworker said my face looked lopsided.
N: When I stood up, the room was bright, my coffee had gone cold, and my coworker said the meeting had started.

S: Our sailboat's mast snapped in the gale, and water was coming in faster than we could pump it out.
N: Our sailboat's mast was repainted at the marina, and the water was flat as we pumped up the dinghy.

S: I heard my name called from the dark basement, though I was the only one at home.
N: I heard my name called from the kitchen, where my brother was making dinner at home.

S: The school nurse called to say my daughter had fainted in class and was not responding normally.
N: The school nurse called to say my daughter's eye test was done and the form was in her bag.

S: A swarm of bees surrounded my head on the trail, and I am allergic and had left my epinephrine pen at home.
N: A group of hikers passed me on the trail, and I had brought my water bottle and left my jacket at home.

S: My visa interview was in an hour, and I realized my passport was not in my bag or my coat.
N: My visa interview was in an hour, and I checked that my passport was in my bag next to my coat.

S: The construction crane above the street began tilting, and the load it carried swung toward the sidewalk where I stood.
N: The construction crane above the street began turning, and the load it carried was lowered onto the site behind the fence.

S: The wheel of my motorcycle hit an oil slick in the turn, and the bike leaned further than I could hold it.
N: The wheel of my motorcycle rolled over a painted line in the turn, and the bike leaned at its usual angle.

S: A woman on the bus said she had just come from a ward with a dangerous virus, then coughed directly on me.
N: A woman on the bus said she had just come from the library with a new novel, then sat down next to me.

S: My son called from abroad, said he had been arrested, and the line cut off before he could say where.
N: My son called from abroad, said he had arrived at the hotel, and the line cut off as he entered the elevator.

S: The doctor told me my baby's heartbeat was not showing on the monitor and left to get another machine.
N: The doctor told me my baby's checkup was finished and left to get the vaccination schedule from the desk.

S: The door to the cold storage room shut behind me, and the handle on the inside had been removed.
N: The door to the storage room shut behind me, and the handle on the inside had been replaced last week.
